pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark brown polygonal regions with serrated, high-frequency edge boundaries. Patches are largest on the mid-flank, becoming smaller and more densely clustered toward the rump.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light cream pathways forming trivalent and quadrivalent junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the pathways remains consistently narrow throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a continuous jagged silhouette along the upper neck with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations visible against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: An abrupt discontinuity in the mane profile is visible at the junction between the neck and the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized area of textural disruption and greyish de-pigmentation is visible on the upper flank near the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear scar or lesion is visible across the central flank, cutting through the continuity of multiple dark patches.
